```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
    //@             (k >= a.length ==> \result[k] == b[k - a.length]));
    //@ ensures \result != a && \result != b;
    //@ also
    //@ requires a == null || b == null || (long)a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == null;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;

    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i; ret[k] == a[k]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < m; ret[k] == a[k]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; m <= k < m + i; ret[k] == b[k - m]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k; m + i <= k < m + n; ret[k] == 0);
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {

            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
```

```
    //@  requires \exists int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == elem;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures 0 <= \result < arr.length;

    //@  ensures arr[\result] == elem;
    //@ also

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {

        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
```

```
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {
```

```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] == \old(arr[j]) / 2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < arr.length; arr[k] == \old(arr[k]);
        //@ loop_writes arr[*], i;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

```
```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;
```

```
        /*@

          @ loop_invariant (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0)
          @     || (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1)
          @     || (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8)
          @     || (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9)
          @     || (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6))
          @ );
          @ loop_invariant digits != null && len == digits.length;
          @ decreases (len / 2) - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
```

```
    //@ requires digits != null ==> digits.length >= 0;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result == (
    //@   digits == null || digits.length == 0
    //@   || (
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length / 2;
    //@       ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@     )
    //@     && (
    //@       (digits.length % 2 == 1) 
    //@       ? (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
    //@       : true
    //@     )
    //@   )
    //@ );
    //@ also
    //@ ensures digits == null || digits.length == 0 ==> \result == true;
    //@ ensures digits != null && digits.length > 0 ==> (
    //@   \result == (
    //@     (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length / 2;
    //@       ((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@     )
    //@     && (
    //@       (digits.length % 2 == 1) 
    //@       ? (digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
    //@       : true
    //@     )
    //@   )
    //@ );
    //@ also
    //@ ensures digits != null && digits.length > 0 && !\result ==> (
    //@   (\exists int i; 0 <= i && i < digits.length / 2;
    //@       !((digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9)
    //@       || (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6))
    //@     )
    //@     || (
    //@       (digits.length % 2 == 1) 
    //@       && !(digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8)
    //@     )
    //@ );
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        /*@ 
          @ loop_invariant 0 <= i && i <= len / 2;
          @ loop_invariant (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i;
          @     ((digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0)
          @     || (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1)
          @     || (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8)
          @     || (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9)
          @     || (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6))
          @ );
          @ loop_invariant digits != null && len == digits.length;
          @ decreases (len / 2) - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;
```

```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

                return null;

    }
}
```

```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= nVert;
          @ maintaining (\forall int a,b; 0 <= a < i && a < b && b < nVert; adjacencyMat[a][b] == adjacencyMat[b][a]);
          @ decreases nVert - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            /*@ 
              @ maintaining i < nVert;
              @ maintaining i <= nVert;
              @ maintaining 0 <= j && j <= nVert;
              @ maintaining (\forall int l; i+1 <= l < j; adjacencyMat[i][l] == adjacencyMat[l][i]);
              @ decreases nVert - j;
              @*/
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == -1;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ pure
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] != elem;
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
```

To fix the LoopInvariantBeforeLoop error, the loop invariant must hold before the first iteration, i.e., at i = 0. At i=0, the forall statements over 0 <= j < 0 are vacuously true, so inc and dec must be true initially. The code already initializes inc and dec to true, so the invariants hold initially.

But the error indicates the prover cannot establish "0 <= i <= n - 1" before the loop. The problem is that at loop entry, i is 0, and the invariant says i <= n - 1. However, if n == 0 or n == 1, then n - 1 is -1 or 0, so i=0 <= n-1 may be false if n=0.

Since the loop runs from i=0 to i < n - 1, the loop executes only if n >= 2. So the loop invariant's upper bound for i should be i <= n - 1 only if n >= 1.

To fix this, we can strengthen the precondition to require nums.length >= 1, or adjust the invariant to allow the case when n < 2.

Better is to adjust the invariant to:

0 <= i <= n - 1 when n >= 1, and 0 <= i <= 0 when n < 2.

Alternatively, we can write:

0 <= i <= n - 1 || (n <= 1 && i == 0)

But since the loop runs only when i < n - 1, if n < 2, the loop body does not execute at all.

So the loop invariant should be:

0 <= i <= n - 1 && (n >= 1) || i == 0 && n <= 1

But this is complicated.

A simpler approach is to change the loop invariant to:

0 <= i <= n - 1 || (n <= 1 && i == 0)

and add a case for n <= 1.

Alternatively, we can write the loop invariant as:

0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || i == 0 && n <= 1

But JML does not support disjunctions easily in loop invariants.

Alternatively, we can weaken the invariant to:

0 <= i && i <= n - 1 + (n == 0 ? 1 : 0)

But this is complicated.

The simplest fix is to change the loop invariant to:

0 <= i && i <= n - 1 || (n <= 1 && i == 0)

and add a loop invariant clause:

//@ maintaining (n <= 1 ==> i == 0);

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    public static int find(int[] arr, int elem) {
        if (arr == null)
            return -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)
            if (arr[i] == elem)
                return i;
        return -1;
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class Mul {
    public static long mul(int x, int y) {
        int m = x, n = y, sign = 1;
        if (x < 0) {
            m = -x;
            sign = -sign;
        }
        if (y < 0) {
            n = -y;
            sign = -sign;
        }

        long res = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                res = res + 1;
            }
        }
        return sign * res;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

    }
```

```
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
```

```
public class ReverseArray {
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
            return false;

```
```
public class TitleCase {
```
```java
    /*@ 
      @ requires true;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures (arr == null && \result == null) || 
      @         (arr != null && \result != null && \fresh(\result) && \result.length == arr.length &&
      @          (\forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length;
      @              (Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]) &&
      @              (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==>
      @                 (\exists int j; 0 <= j <= i &&
      @                     (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1])) &&
      @                     \result[i] == (i == j ? Character.toTitleCase(arr[i]) : Character.toLowerCase(arr[i]))
      @                 )
      @              )
      @          )
      @         );
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        /*@ 
          @ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
          @ maintaining (\forall int k; 0 <= k < i;
          @     (Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == arr[k]) &&
          @     (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==>
          @         ((k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1])) && ret[k] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[k]) ||
          @          !(k == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[k-1])) && ret[k] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[k]))
          @     )
          @ );
          @ maintaining wordStart == (i == 0 || (i > 0 && Character.isWhitespace(arr[i-1])));
          @ decreases n - i;
          @*/
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
            }
        }

        return c;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0) return false;

        int n = a.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] == null || a[i].length != n) return false;

            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (i == j) {
                    if (a[i][j] != 1) return false;
                } else {
                    if (a[i][j] != 0) return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {

                index = index + 1;

        }
        return true;
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@ requires (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i] != null);
    //@ requires mat.length == 0 || (\forall int i; 0 <= i < mat.length; mat[i].length == mat[0].length);

    //@   mat.length == 0 ||

    //@ );
```

```
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            return false;
```

```
        int i = 0;
```
```
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
```

```
    //@  assigns \nothing;

            return false;
```

```
    //@ requires true;
```
```
    //@ assigns \nothing;
```
```
    //@ ensures (vec == null && \result == null)
    //@         || (vec != null &&
    //@             \result != null &&

    //@             \fresh(\result) &&

    //@             (\forall int i; 0 <= i < vec.length;
```
```java
    //@                 ((long)vec[i] * (long)a > Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> \result[i] == Integer.MAX_VALUE)
    //@                 && ((long)vec[i] * (long)a < Integer.MIN_VALUE ==> \result[i] == Integer.MIN_VALUE)
    //@                 && (Integer.MIN_VALUE <= (long)vec[i] * (long)a && (long)vec[i] * (long)a <= Integer.MAX_VALUE
    //@                     ==> \result[i] == (int)((long)vec[i] * (long)a))
    //@             ) &&
```
```
    //@             // No elements are reordered or lost: the result is a pointwise saturated product of vec and a
    //@             // The returned array is freshly allocated and distinct from input
    //@             \result != vec
    //@         );
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= vec.length;
        //@ maintaining ret.length == vec.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@     ((long)vec[j] * (long)a > Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> ret[j] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) &&
        //@     ((long)vec[j] * (long)a < Integer.MIN_VALUE ==> ret[j] == Integer.MIN_VALUE) &&
        //@     (Integer.MIN_VALUE <= (long)vec[j] * (long)a && (long)vec[j] * (long)a <= Integer.MAX_VALUE ==> ret[j] == (int)((long)vec[j] * (long)a));

        //@ decreases vec.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
```
